# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released major version of PyMAB.
Users should upgrade to the newest patch release before reporting an issue.
Pre-release branches and unsupported older releases may receive a fix at the
maintainers' discretion, but no response timeline is guaranteed for them.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use GitHub's
**Security > Report a vulnerability** workflow to submit a private report to
the maintainers. Include the affected version, a minimal reproduction, the
expected impact, and any suggested mitigation. Please avoid accessing data that
you do not own and allow the maintainers a reasonable opportunity to investigate
before public disclosure.

The maintainers will acknowledge a complete report, assess severity, coordinate
a fix and release where needed, and credit the reporter unless anonymity is
requested. Ordinary correctness bugs without a security impact belong in the
public issue tracker.
